decisions.reason: Premium support builds on the firm's core promise of round-the-clock expert service for agencies, so dropping it would contradict its public positioning, and keeping it costs little.
The version manager was developed in-house, has its own page and is promoted alongside the firm's flagship tools, so the sunk development effort and visible commitment favor keeping it.

The contract tool is distant from the core business and likely cheap to retire, but it was presented on a page of its own and its GDPR relevance still gives agency customers a reason to use it, so it narrowly stays.
Scalable agency hosting was featured on the home page and sits at the center of the firm's agency-focused direction, so withdrawing it would expose a strategic misstep.
